title: Web need: download a score's kit as a drum rack preset
description:
## Intent

Describe what the web app would need to offer kit export; the web/docs session decides the visuals (see AGENTS.md: UI changes go through a Kanbus issue).

## The need

- On the Score view, for each kit the score defines, an action "Download as drum rack preset" that produces the same `.adg` the CLI writes.
- Where the bytes come from: either the wasm engine (`crates/apricity-web` calling `apricity-daw`, which builds for wasm32-wasip1) or the local server (`apricity serve`) with an endpoint like `GET /export/kit?score=...&kit=...`.
- A preset downloaded from the browser references audio paths on the user's machine; in cloud mode those files are not local. The UI needs to say that the preset works with a local library, or offer a zip with the audio (decision for the owner, see M0 decisions task).

## Out of scope

Building the UI in this initiative.

## Verification

The web session's own issue records its verification; this task is done when the need is accepted there (comment with that issue's id).

## Release

No product commit here.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI task.
